summary: Patch correctly fixes DateFormat.Y() to zero-pad years below 1000 by formatting with '%04d', matching the documented four-digit behavior. Minimal, targeted change with updated docstring; matches the repo's existing '%02d' idiom used in y(). One subtle return-type change (int → str) is consistent with all other DateFormat methods, which return strings.

issues.description: Return type changes from int to str. This is the correct/intended behavior (all other format specifiers return strings and format() joins them), and the previous int return was the bug, so any code relying on the int was already broken. Non-blocking.
